title: What's new in Expense Agent: Mobile App ( Preview) (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to Expense Agent mobile app capabilities
Receipt scanning with auto capture and bulk upload
Uploading receipts from gallery via share functionality
Offline mode for receipt handling and categorization
Submission and approval workflow in mobile app
Summary of mobile app feature parity with web app
Availability and preview status of the mobile app

features.name: Receipt scanning with auto capture
features.description: Native capability to automatically capture receipts directly from the phone camera in the Expense Agent mobile app.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Bulk receipt upload
features.description: Ability to upload multiple receipts at the same time from the mobile app before processing.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Gallery share functionality for receipts
features.description: Integration with operating system share functionality to send photos from gallery directly to the Expense Agent mobile app for processing.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Mileage expense creation on mobile
features.description: Create mileage expenses directly from the phone with route selection, vehicle type, distance calculation, and automatic per diem rate calculation.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Offline mode for receipt handling
features.description: Add receipts and expenses to the app while offline without immediate processing; expenses are queued and processed once connection is restored.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.
caveats: No local processing; processing happens after reconnection

features.name: Expense submission on mobile
features.description: Submit expense reports from the mobile app to approvers, with the same workflow as the web app.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Expense approval on mobile
features.description: Review, check compliance issues, override flags, and approve expense reports directly from the mobile app.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.

features.name: Expense categorization and agent processing
features.description: Automatic recognition and categorization of uploaded expenses and receipts into expense reports by the Expense Agent.
features.status_evidence_quote: you can try it out right now. But be mindful because it's still in preview.
